Which statement about acceleration is correct?
A
It is related to the changing speed of an object.
B
It is the distance an object travels in one second.
C
It is the force acting on an object divided by the distance it travels in one second.
D
It is the force acting on an object when it is near to the Earth.

options.label: A
options.text: It is related to the changing speed of an object.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the distance an object travels in one second.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the force acting on an object divided by the distance it travels in one second.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the force acting on an object when it is near to the Earth.
